§11_open_risks.description: express-rate-limit uses in-memory MemoryStore. Counter resets on process restart and is not shared across multiple instances.
§11_open_risks.mitigation: DB-backed account lockout (sos_user_accounts.failed_login_count) provides durable defense. Rate limiter in-memory gap is a second-layer concern.
§11_open_risks.requirement: Replace MemoryStore with Redis or PostgreSQL rate-limit store before multi-instance production deployment.

§11_open_risks.description: No DB trigger or row-security policy prevents UPDATE/DELETE on sos_auth_audit. Convention-only enforcement.
§11_open_risks.mitigation: Application code never issues UPDATE/DELETE on sos_auth_audit.
§11_open_risks.requirement: Add PostgreSQL trigger or revoke UPDATE/DELETE privileges on sos_auth_audit in Phase 3.

§11_open_risks.description: GET /session returns userId as displayName when staff profile is not found by userId (staffProfiles.userId = identityRef.id, not user_account.id).
§11_open_risks.mitigation: Functional gap, not a security issue. Staff profile query needs to join through identity refs.
